evals.name: new-product-brand-from-problem-and-references
evals.prompt: I found a problem for independent pharmacies: staff spend too much time reconciling stock counts, purchase records, and low-stock alerts across spreadsheets and WhatsApp. I want to turn it into a SaaS. Here are two reference sites I like for how polished their products feel. Study the references and create a product-specific brand and design system for this solution. Do not make it look like my personal brand and do not clone either reference.
evals.expected_output: A product-specific brand direction grounded in the problem and references, with positioning, personality, visual system, UX principles, anti-generic-AI review, and implementation artifacts.

evals.name: clone-request-reframed-into-original-system
evals.prompt: I want this new B2B workflow product to look exactly like the website I am sending you. Extract everything and tell Antigravity how to reproduce it pixel-for-pixel.
evals.expected_output: The skill should reframe the task toward extracting transferable design principles and producing an original product-specific system rather than directly cloning identity, copy, assets, or distinctive composition.

evals.name: avoid-ai-generated-saas-look
evals.prompt: The product works, but the UI looks like it came from an AI website generator: gradients everywhere, rounded cards, giant headings, and generic dashboard sections. I want it to feel like a real product designed intentionally for operations teams.
evals.expected_output: A practical visual/UX review that identifies generic signals, ties improvements to the actual workflow, and produces a more product-specific system without imposing a single aesthetic.

evals.name: do-not-trigger-personal-site-work
evals.prompt: Help me adjust the spacing and button radius on my personal portfolio website.
evals.expected_output: The product brand skill should not be needed because this is the personal website rather than a new product identity task.

evals.name: preserve-existing-product-brand
evals.prompt: Our SaaS already has an approved brand system and customer-validated UI. I only want the settings page to use the existing components correctly.
evals.expected_output: Do not redesign the brand. Work within the existing system and solve the local UI implementation issue.
